title: 'Uniclear' water-based brain clearing for light sheet imaging of electrode tracks
author: Susu Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zndf5a6

steps.title: Perfuse and post‑fix brain
steps.instruction: Perfuse mouse with cold 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA), then post‑fix the extracted brain in 4 % PFA for at least 24 h at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Wash brain in PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the post‑fixed brain thoroughly in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) to remove fixative; brains may be kept in PBS at 4 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Delipidate brain in SBiP
steps.instruction: Incubate each adult mouse brain in 20 mL SBiP buffer, shaking at 70 rpm and 37 °C. On day 1 replace the buffer at 03:00, 06:00 and 12:00, then leave overnight. From day 2 onward replace the SBiP buffer every 24 h for a total of 14 consecutive days, maintaining shaking at 70 rpm and 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Day 1: change SBiP buffer at 03:00, 06:00, and 12:00, then keep overnight.
Days 2‑15: change SBiP buffer every 24 h for 14 days total.

steps.title: Post‑delipidation PBS wash
steps.instruction: After the 14‑day delipidation, wash the brain in PBS for at least 12 h before any further processing; the sample can be stored in PBS at RT pending refractive‑index matching.

steps.title: Refractive index matching
steps.instruction: Day 1: Transfer the brain to 20 mL of a 1:1 mixture of PBS and Opti‑Prep, rotate at RT for 24 h. Day 2: Move the brain to 40 mL of 100 % Opti‑Prep, rotate at RT for another 24 h. The brain should become transparent.

substeps.instruction: Day 1 – 20 mL 50 % PBS + 50 % Opti‑Prep, rotate 24 h at RT.
Day 2 – 40 mL 100 % Opti‑Prep, rotate 24 h at RT.

steps.title: Mount brain for light‑sheet
steps.instruction: Mount the cleared brain vertically on the Zeiss Z1 light‑sheet microscope (or equivalent). Optional DNA dye YO‑PRO may be added for fluorescence; for electrode localization use tissue autofluorescence (488 nm laser) and for CM‑Dil tracks use a 561 nm laser.

steps.title: Acquire light‑sheet images
steps.instruction: Image the brain with a voxel size of 1.22 µm × 1.22 µm × 8 µm using a 5× objective on the Z1; collect autofluorescence (488 nm) and CM‑Dil (561 nm) channels as needed.
